body:
Sometimes, when building the docker image, `tlmgr` fails to update.

See:

- [Concerning problems with updates from mirror.ctan](https://tug.org/pipermail/tex-live/2021-April/046808.html)
- [tlmgr bad signature](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/519037/tlmgr-bad-signature)

Sample error log:
```
#24 [latex_base 3/4] RUN tlmgr update -self
#24 3.783 
#24 3.783 /home/pandoc/.TinyTeX/bin/x86_64-linuxmusl//tlmgr: signature verification error of /tmp/1Hmv95VJDW/N7M_RIwjtC from https://us.mirrors.cicku.me/ctan/systems/texlive/tlnet/tlpkg/texlive.tlpdb: cryptographic signature verification of
#24 3.783   /tmp/1Hmv95VJDW/40cVCime71
#24 3.783 against
#24 3.783   https://us.mirrors.cicku.me/ctan/systems/texlive/tlnet/tlpkg/texlive.tlpdb.sha512.asc
#24 3.783 failed. Output was:
#24 3.783 gpg: Signature made Mon Jan 22 00:46:21 2024 UTC
#24 3.783 gpg:                using RSA key D8F2F86057A857E42A88106A4CE1877E19438C70
#24 3.783 gpg: BAD signature from "TeX Live Distribution <tex-live@tug.org>" [ultimate]
#24 3.783 
#24 3.783 Please try from a different mirror and/or wait a few minutes
#24 3.783 and try again; usually this is because of transient updates.
#24 3.783 If problems persist, feel free to report to texlive@tug.org.
#24 3.783 
#24 ERROR: process "/bin/sh -c tlmgr update -self" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1
------
 > [latex_base 3/4] RUN tlmgr update -self:
3.783   https://us.mirrors.cicku.me/ctan/systems/texlive/tlnet/tlpkg/texlive.tlpdb.sha512.asc
3.783 failed. Output was:
3.783 gpg: Signature made Mon Jan 22 00:46:21 2024 UTC
3.783 gpg:                using RSA key D8F2F86057A857E42A88106A4CE1877E19438C70
3.783 gpg: BAD signature from "TeX Live Distribution <tex-live@tug.org>" [ultimate]
3.783 
3.783 Please try from a different mirror and/or wait a few minutes
3.783 and try again; usually this is because of transient updates.
3.783 If problems persist, feel free to report to texlive@tug.org.
3.783 
------
```

labels.name: _5.0 - Not blocker
labels.description: This issue does not block 5.0 so if it gets addressed then great, if not then fine.

title: `tlmgr` sometimes fails to update
